task_completion.description: Launch CoppeliaSim and ensure the ZMQ Remote API is active on port 23000.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The CoppeliaSim GUI is visible, and the status bar or a terminal window shows the ZMQ plugin has started or is listening on port 23000.

task_completion.description: Execute a script or program that iterates through at least 8 distinct PID gain combinations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A code editor (e.g., VS Code) or terminal shows a script running with loops or a list of at least 8 sets of P, I, and D values within the specified ranges.

task_completion.description: Observe the robot arm joint performing step response movements (e.g., 0 to 45 degrees) in the simulation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots of the CoppeliaSim 3D view showing the robot arm joint moving to different positions repeatedly during the tuning process.

task_completion.description: Generate the CSV file containing the 8 trials with all required performance metrics.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or terminal 'cat' command shows /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/pid_tuning_data.csv exists with columns: trial_id, kp, ki, kd, overshoot_pct, settling_time_s, rise_time_s, and steady_state_error_deg.

task_completion.description: Generate the JSON summary report recommending the best-performing gain set.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or text editor shows /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/pid_tuning_report.json containing keys like best_kp, best_ki, best_kd, and selection_criterion.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually ran the simulation rather than just creating files manually.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the CoppeliaSim simulation clock advancing or the 'Play' button active while the script is running.

integrity.description: Ensure the PID metrics (overshoot, settling time) vary across trials and are not identical placeholder values.
integrity.visual_evidence: The CSV file content shows different numerical values for performance metrics across the 8 trials, reflecting actual physical simulation behavior.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the exact file paths specified in the instructions.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal or file manager shows the files located specifically in /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must produce two specific files: a CSV at /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/pid_tuning_data.csv with at least 8 rows of data, and a JSON at /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/pid_tuning_report.json. The PID ranges must be P (0.1-5.0), I (0.0-0.5), and D (0.0-1.0). The ZMQ API must be accessed via port 23000.
